```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
```

# Read in blood pea

### NOTE - database of proximity extension assays, which detect relative protein levels in the blood. Gives genes (which correpond to proteins) logFC values that correspond with changes relative to healthy controls or other disease conditions.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa_pea <- read_tsv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/hpa/blood_pea_disease_de.tsv")
```


## Filter for cancer as the disease and for healthy as the control and remove the unnecessary columns

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa_pea <- hpa_pea %>%
  dplyr::filter(Class == "Cancer", Control == "Healthy")

hpa_pea <- hpa_pea[, !names(hpa_pea) %in% c("Seeds", 
                                            "Mean importance", 
                                            "SD importance", 
                                            "Min importance", 
                                            "Max importance")]
```


## Identify logFC values of tumour secreted ligands (Tnf, Ccl12 which is Ccl2 in humans Cxcl12, Osm) found to regulate the muscle from our mouse analyses. These values are in the blood of tumour-bearing humans relative to healthy controls.

```{r}
target_proteins <- c("TNF", "CCL2", "CXCL12", "OSM")

hpa_pea_targets <- hpa_pea %>%
  filter(Gene %in% target_proteins)
```


## Add a column for cachexia risk

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa_pea_targets <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  mutate(Cachexia_risk = case_when(
    
    Disease %in% c(
      "Pancreatic cancer",
      "Lung cancer",
      "Colorectal cancer",
      "Hepatocellular cancer"
    ) ~ "High cachectic",
    
    Disease %in% c(
      "Metastatic melanoma",
      "Ovarian cancer",
      "Breast cancer",
      "Cervical cancer",
      "Endometrial cancer"
    ) ~ "Moderate cachectic",
    
    TRUE ~ "Low cachectic"
  ))

hpa_pea_targets$Cachexia_risk <- factor(
  hpa_pea_targets$Cachexia_risk,
  levels = c("Low cachectic", "Moderate cachectic", "High cachectic")
)
```


## Plot blood protein levels

### Define cancers from most to least cachectic

```{r, include=FALSE}
cachexia_order <- c(
  "Prostate cancer",
  "Cervical cancer",
  "Metastatic melanoma",
  "Breast ductal carcinoma in situ",
  "Breast cancer",
  
  "Chronic lymphocytic leukemia",
  "Acute myeloid leukemia",
  "Myeloma",
  "Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma",
  "Meningioma",
  "Glioma",
  "Pituitary neuroendocrine tumor",
  "Endometrial cancer",
  "Ovarian cancer",
  
  "Small intestine neuroendocrine tumor",
  "Colorectal cancer",
  "Lung cancer",
  "Hepatocellular cancer",
  "Pancreatic cancer"
)
```

### Filter genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
tnf_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "TNF") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))

ccl2_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "CCL2") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))

cxcl12_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "CXCL12") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))

osm_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "OSM") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))
```

### Plot TNF

```{r}
ggplot(
  tnf_df %>% mutate(Disease = factor(Disease, levels = cachexia_order)),
  aes(x = Disease, y = logFC, fill = p_plot)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(min(tnf_df$p_plot, na.rm = TRUE), 0.05),
    na.value = "black",
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 3)) +
  labs(
    title = "Plasma TNF",
    x = "Cancer type (ranked by cachexia potential)",
    y = "logFC (relative to healthy controls)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## TNF differences between cachexia risk

### 1-way ANOVA to compare plasma values between cachexia risks

```{r}
tnf_anova <- aov(logFC ~ Cachexia_risk, data = tnf_df)

summary(tnf_anova)
```

### Plot

```{r}
ggplot(tnf_df, aes(x = Cachexia_risk, y = logFC, fill = Cachexia_risk)) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "solid",
    size = 0.6
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "bar",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_sdl,
    fun.args = list(mult = 1),
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Disease),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High cachectic" = "#666666",
    "Moderate cachectic" = "lightgrey",
    "Low cachectic" = "white"
  )) +
  
  labs(
  x = NULL,
  y = "Plasma TNF logFC (relative to healthy)"
) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 2)) +
  
  theme_classic()
```

# Read in tumour RNA

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumour_rna <- read_tsv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/hpa/rna_cancer_sample.tsv")
```


## Add gene names to data.frame

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Clean Ensembl IDs (remove version numbers if present)
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(Gene_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Gene))

# Create mapping table
gene_map <- data.frame(
  ensembl_gene_id = unique(tumour_rna$Gene_clean),
  hgnc_symbol = mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = unique(tumour_rna$Gene_clean),
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
)

# Join back to your dataframe
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  left_join(gene_map,
            by = c("Gene_clean" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  rename(Gene_symbol = hgnc_symbol)

# Drop NA values
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  drop_na(Gene_symbol)

# Clean Cancer names
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(
    Cancer = sub(" \\(.*\\)", "", Cancer)
  )

# Fix spelling of Cuteneous to Cutaneous
tumour_rna$Cancer <- gsub(
  "Skin Cuteneous Melanoma",
  "Skin Cutaneous Melanoma",
  tumour_rna$Cancer
)
```


## Define  cancers from least to most cachectic (according to Anker et al. 2019, Rajan et al. 2025, Callaway et al. 2023, Kelly et al. 2026)

```{r, include=FALSE}
cachexia_order <- c(
  "Prostate Adenocarcinoma",
  "Testicular Germ Cell Tumor",
  "Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma",
  "Skin Cutaneous Melanoma",
  "Breast Invasive Carcinoma",
  "Thyroid Carcinoma",

  "Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma",
  "Glioblastoma Multiforme",
  "Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma",
  "Kidney Chromophobe",
  "Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma",
  "Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma",
  "Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma",

  "Rectum Adenocarcinoma",
  "Stomach Adenocarcinoma",
  "Colon Adenocarcinoma",
  "Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma",

  "Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
  "Lung Adenocarcinoma",
  "Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma",
  "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma"
)
```


## Add a column for very high, high, moderate, and low risk of cachexia

```{r}
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(Cachexia_risk = case_when(
    Cancer %in% c(
      "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma",
      "Lung Adenocarcinoma",
      "Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
      "Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma"
    ) ~ "Very High-risk",
    
    Cancer %in% c(
      "Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
      "Rectum Adenocarcinoma",
      "Colon Adenocarcinoma",
      "Stomach Adenocarcinoma"
    ) ~ "High-risk",
    
    Cancer %in% c(
      "Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma",
      "Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma",
      "Kidney Chromophobe",
      "Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma",
      "Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma",
      "Glioblastoma Multiforme",
      "Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma"
    ) ~ "Moderate-risk",
    
    Cancer %in% c(
      "Thyroid Carcinoma",
      "Testicular Germ Cell Tumor",
      "Prostate Adenocarcinoma",
      "Skin Cutaneous Melanoma",
      "Breast Invasive Carcinoma",
      "Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma"
    ) ~ "Low-risk"
  ))

tumour_rna$Cachexia_risk <- factor(tumour_rna$Cachexia_risk, 
                               levels = c("Low-risk", "Moderate-risk", "High-risk", "Very High-risk"))
```


## Make Cancer column a factor

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(Cancer = factor(Cancer, levels = cachexia_order))
```


## Filter genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
tnf_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "TNF")

ccl2_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "CCL2")

cxcl12_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "CXCL12")

osm_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "OSM")
```


## Plot 

### Plot TNF

```{r}
ggplot(tnf_df, aes(x = Cancer, y = pTPM)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +  # points
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, color = "red", size = 0.7, fatten = 2) +  # mean line
  labs(
    title = "TNF pTPM across Cancer Types",
    x = "Cancer Type (ranked by cachexia potential)",
    y = "pTPM"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

#### Mean TNF pTPM values by Cancer type

```{r}
tnf_df %>%
  group_by(Cancer) %>%
  summarize(mean_pTPM = mean(pTPM, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## TNF differences between cachexia risk

### Mean TNF pTPM values by Cachexia_risk

```{r}
tnf_df %>%
  group_by(Cachexia_risk) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pTPM = mean(pTPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```


### 1-way ANOVA to compare pTPM values between cachexia risks

```{r}
tnf_anova <- aov(pTPM ~ Cachexia_risk, data = tnf_df)

summary(tnf_anova)
```

### Tukey's post-hoc testing

```{r}
tnf_posthoc <- TukeyHSD(tnf_anova)

tnf_posthoc$Cachexia_risk
```

### Plot (log transformed axes to see differences)

```{r}
ggplot(tnf_df, aes(x = Cachexia_risk, y = pTPM, fill = Cachexia_risk)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +  # log-transform the y-axis
  labs(
    title = "TNF",
    y = "pTPM (log10 scale)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Very High-risk" = "#666666",
    "High-risk" = "darkgrey",
    "Moderate-risk" = "lightgrey",
    "Low-risk" = "white"
  ))
```

```{r}
cxcl12_anova <- aov(pTPM ~ Cachexia_risk, data = cxcl12_df)

summary(cxcl12_anova)
```

### Tukey's post-hoc testing

```{r}
cxcl12_posthoc <- TukeyHSD(cxcl12_anova)

cxcl12_posthoc$Cachexia_risk
```

### Plot (log transformed axes to see differences)

```{r}
ggplot(cxcl12_df, aes(x = Cachexia_risk, y = pTPM, fill = Cachexia_risk)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +  # log-transform the y-axis
  labs(
    title = "CXCL12",
    y = "pTPM (log10 scale)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Very High-risk" = "#666666",
    "High-risk" = "darkgrey",
    "Moderate-risk" = "lightgrey",
    "Low-risk" = "white"
  ))
```

# Read in tumour cptac

### NOTE - CPTAC is "Clinical Proteomic tumour Analysis Consortium". Measured as a logFC relative to healthy tissue.

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumour_cptac <- read_tsv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/hpa/cancer_cptac.tsv")
```


## Identify logFC values of tumour secreted ligands (Tnf, Ccl12 which is Ccl2 in humans Cxcl12, Osm) found to regulate the muscle from our mouse analyses.

```{r}
target_proteins <- c("TNF", "CCL2", "CXCL12", "OSM")

tumour_cptac_targets <- tumour_cptac %>%
  filter(`Gene name` %in% target_proteins) %>%
  filter(`p-value adjusted` < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))
```

### NOTE - No OSM protein found in the tumour (apparently secreted by immune cells, it does have OSMR though). When filtering for p<0.05, only CXCL12 remains. 


## Order cancers from least to most cachectic

```{r, include=FALSE}
cachexia_order <- c(
  "Endometrioid AC",
  "Uterine CEC",
  "Renal cell carcinoma",
  "Colon AC",
  "Head and Neck SQCC",
  "Lung SQCC",
  "Lung AC",
  "Liver HC",
  "Pancreatic DAC"
)
```


## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(
  tumour_cptac_targets %>% mutate(Cancer = factor(Cancer, levels = cachexia_order)),
  aes(x = Cancer, y = logFC, fill = p_plot)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(min(tumour_cptac_targets$p_plot, na.rm = TRUE), 0.05),
    na.value = "black",
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumour CXCL12",
    x = "Cancer type (ranked by cachexia potential)",
    y = "logFC (relative to healthy tissue)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(tumour_cptac, tumour_cptac_targets, cachexia_order, target_proteins)
```

## Map mouse genes to human orthologs

### NOTE - I downloaded a file from BioMart that has matching human and mouse genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
orthologs <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/human_mouse_orthologs.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "", fill = TRUE)

# Filter for high-confidence orthologs
orthologs_hc <- orthologs %>%
  filter(orthology_confidence == 1)

# Map mouse genes to human genes
tnf_targets_human <- orthologs_hc %>%
  filter(mouse_gene_name %in% tnf_targets) %>%
  pull(human_gene_name) %>% 
  unique()   # remove duplicates

ccl2_targets_human <- orthologs_hc %>%
  filter(mouse_gene_name %in% ccl12_targets) %>%
  pull(human_gene_name) %>% 
  unique()   # remove duplicates

cxcl12_targets_human <- orthologs_hc %>%
  filter(mouse_gene_name %in% cxcl12_targets) %>%
  pull(human_gene_name) %>% 
  unique()   # remove duplicates

osm_targets_human <- orthologs_hc %>%
  filter(mouse_gene_name %in% osm_targets) %>%
  pull(human_gene_name) %>% 
  unique()
```



# TNF target genes in Monocytes/macrophages

### DEGs by condition

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_muscle) <- "seurat_clusters"

pdac_mono_macro <- subset(pdac_muscle, idents = "Monocytes/macrophages")

Idents(pdac_mono_macro) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_ws_v_ctl <- FindMarkers(pdac_mono_macro, ident.1 = "PDAC_WS", ident.2 = "PDAC_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ctl <- FindMarkers(pdac_mono_macro, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = "PDAC_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ws <- FindMarkers(pdac_mono_macro, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = "PDAC_WS", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_ws_v_ctl <- DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_ws_v_ctl %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ctl <- DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ctl %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ws <- DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ws %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
```


### See which genes are up in cachectic vs. CTL and cachectic vs. WS but not WS vs. CTL

```{r}
# Filter each DEG table for significant upregulation
tnf_sig_cac_vs_ctl <- DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ctl %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2,
    p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  rownames()

tnf_sig_cac_vs_ws <- DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_cac_v_ws %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2,
    p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  rownames()

tnf_sig_ws_vs_ctl <- DEGs_tnf_mono_macro_ws_v_ctl %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2,
    p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  rownames()

# Genes that are significant in both cac comparisons but NOT in WS vs CTL
cachectic_tnf_mono_macro_genes <- intersect(tnf_sig_cac_vs_ctl, tnf_sig_cac_vs_ws) %>%
  setdiff(tnf_sig_ws_vs_ctl)

# Show result
cachectic_tnf_mono_macro_genes
```

### Check to see if any genes are up in cachexia that line up with the target genes

```{r}
intersect(tnf_targets_human, cachectic_tnf_mono_macro_genes)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
  ident.2 = "PDAC_WS",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.10,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
# Genes that are significant in both CAC comparisons but NOT in WS vs CTL
```

```{r}
) %>%
  setdiff(osm_sig_ws_vs_ctl)

cachectic_osm_ec_genes
```

## Heatmap of DEGs for each gene in tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human

### DEGs by condition

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_muscle) <- "seurat_clusters"

pdac_muscle_immune <- subset(pdac_muscle, idents = c("Monocytes/macrophages", "Neutrophils"))

Idents(pdac_muscle_immune) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle_immune, ident.1 = "PDAC_WS", ident.2 = "PDAC_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle_immune, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = "PDAC_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle_immune, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = "PDAC_WS", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl <- DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
```

### See which genes are up in cachectic vs. CTL and cachectic vs. WS but not WS vs. CTL (no filter by p_val because too few cells, filtered by avg_log2FC > 0.2)

```{r}
# Filter each DEG table for significant upregulation
sig_cac_vs_ctl <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2) %>%
  rownames()

sig_cac_vs_ws <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2) %>%
  rownames()

sig_ws_vs_ctl <- DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2) %>%
  rownames()

# Genes that are significant in both cac comparisons but NOT in WS vs CTL
cachectic_immune_genes <- intersect(sig_cac_vs_ctl, sig_cac_vs_ws) %>%
  setdiff(sig_ws_vs_ctl)

# Show result
cachectic_immune_genes
```

### Specify which of these "up" genes are also in the tnf_ccl2_cxcl2_targets_human list

```{r}
tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_up <- intersect(cachectic_immune_genes, tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human)

tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_up
```

### Plot heatmap, highlight up cachectic genes

```{r}
## Filter target genes to only those present in your DEG tables
tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_present <- tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human[
  tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human %in% rownames(DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl) &
  tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human %in% rownames(DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl) &
  tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human %in% rownames(DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws)
]

## Build heatmap matrix: rows = comparisons, columns = genes
tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix <- t(data.frame(
  "WS vs CTL"  = DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl[tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_present, "avg_log2FC"],
  "CAC vs CTL" = DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl[tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_present, "avg_log2FC"],
  "CAC vs WS"  = DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws[tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_present, "avg_log2FC"]
))
colnames(tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix) <- tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_present
rownames(tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix) <- c("WS vs CTL", "CAC vs CTL", "CAC vs WS")

## Colors for heatmap
tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_colors <- colorRamp2(
  c(-10, 0, 10),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)

## Column label colors: red if gene is in osm_targets_up, black otherwise
gene_label_colors <- ifelse(colnames(tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix) %in% tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_up, "red", "black")

# Heatmap with italicized human gene names
Heatmap(
  tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix,
  name = "avg_log2FC",
  col = tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # Square cells
  width = unit(ncol(tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix)*15, "pt"),
  height = unit(nrow(tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_heatmap_matrix)*15, "pt"),
  
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height,
              gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = "black", lwd = 0.5))
  },
  
  # Column names: colored & italicized
  column_names_gp = gpar(col = gene_label_colors, fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  
  # Row names
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = TRUE,
  column_title = "TNF/CCL2/CXCL12 Target Genes (avg_log2FC)"
)
```

```{r}
gene_label_colors <- ifelse(colnames(heatmap_matrix) %in% osm_targets_up, "red", "black")

## Plot horizontal heatmap
Heatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  name = "avg_log2FC",
  col = heatmap_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # Square cells with borders
  width = unit(ncol(heatmap_matrix)*15, "pt"),
  height = unit(nrow(heatmap_matrix)*15, "pt"),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height,
              gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = "black", lwd = 0.5))
  },
  
  # Column names: gene labels, colored red if in osm_targets_up, italicized
  column_names_gp = gpar(col = gene_label_colors, fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  
  # Row names: comparisons
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "plain"),
  
  border = TRUE,
  column_title = "OSM Target Genes in Non-Immune Cells (avg_log2FC)",
  column_title_side = "top"
)
```
